1.content: Assign a large negative penalty (e.g., -1,000,000) to any move whose destination cell is a hole or is within Manhattan distance 1 of a known hole. Apply this penalty before any other value estimation so such moves are never selected.

2.content: When rating moves, add a positive bonus that scales with the amount by which the move strictly reduces Manhattan distance to the goal, and apply a corresponding penalty proportional to any increase in Manhattan distance.
